### SECTION: Substitute Group Scarcity Indicators (GUI helpers)
### ============================================================
# Each value returns 1 if any good in the demand group is currently
# scarce (any shortage tier) at the evaluated location's market.
#
# Used by location_window.gui demography_item blockoverride to drive
# visibility of per-stratum substitute-goods icons in the Population tab.
#
# Scope when evaluated: location (via Location.MakeScope.ScriptValue)
#
# AUTO-GENERATED by scripts/gen_scarcity.py — do not edit by hand.

    value = 0
    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                market ?= { is_target_in_global_variable_list = { name = SOL_cloth_severe_markets target = this } }
                market ?= { is_target_in_global_variable_list = { name = SOL_cloth_moderate_markets target = this } }

        value = 1
    }
}

sol_grp_knowledge_scarce = {
    value = 0
    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                market ?= { is_target_in_global_variable_list = { name = SOL_paper_severe_markets target = this } }
                market ?= { is_target_in_global_variable_list = { name = SOL_paper_moderate_markets target = this } }
                market ?= { is_target_in_global_variable_list = { name = SOL_paper_mild_markets target = this } }
                market ?= { is_target_in_global_variable_list = { name = SOL_books_severe_markets target = this } }
                market ?= { is_target_in_global_variable_list = { name = SOL_books_moderate_markets target = this } }
                market ?= { is_target_in_global_variable_list = { name = SOL_books_mild_markets target = this } }
            }
        }
        value = 1
    }
}
